set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O02
Accountable role (person not assigned): Operations engineer with institutional operator

Outcome: Operators see and can respond to resource exhaustion, failed work and unavailable dependencies before data stewardship fails.

Acceptance:
- Provide distinct liveness/readiness including the closed recovery gate, redacted structured diagnostics, authorized audit inspection, useful metrics and tested alert delivery.
- Account for accepted/staged/abandoned/backup storage; enforce capacity reservations and bounded queues/concurrency, including streaming response lifetimes and large inventory responses.
- Exercise database outage, disk-full, failed/abandoned imports and cancellation; document escalation, safe service behavior and integrity scrub/repair procedures without enabling unqualified garbage collection.

Evidence anchors:
- modules/app/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/ApiServer.scala
- modules/objects/src/main/scala/sanctity/objects/FileBlobStore.scala
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: O02: Make service health, storage limits and failures observable
